Exceptional Display Performance: Our commercial merchandiser refrigerator delivers double-layer high-transparency glass that keeps out external heat while letting you see the inside without opening the door. Plus, the LED lighting with an independent switch creates an eye-catching lighting experience, showcasing your beverages beautifully. Note: Please let the unit rest for at least 6 hours and then power on after receiving it

11.47 cu.ft / 320 L Large Capacity: Our commercial display refrigerator merchandiser comes with 4 adjustable shelves and multiple fixed slots for easy customization of the interior space. The 11.47 cu.ft / 320 L capacity is excellent for storing beverages in various sizes

Fast Cooling: Our beverage refrigerator cooler merchandiser boasts a powerful compressor and 7-level temperature control (32ºF-50ºF / 0℃-10℃). With an air cooling system, it ensures uniform cooling, chilling your drinks in 45 minutes
